T1.objective: Explore OpenMP work decomposition without changing the scalar pixel recurrence. Contrast static contiguous rows with dynamic/guided row scheduling and, if useful, a contiguous 2D tiled or collapsed-loop partition to test whether row granularity leaves imbalance within expensive rows. Vary chunk sizes only as measured experiments. Use a serial path when it avoids one-thread overhead; never exceed `threads` or change global OpenMP settings. Preserve the original float coordinate and recurrence behavior, write every output, and do not specialize to tested bounds or dimensions. Validate smaller and shifted-bound cases; measure native wall time at one and four cores, including scheduling overhead at n=1024.
T1.subject: Thread-budgeted OpenMP work decomposition

retained: Parallelize the outer row loop with OpenMP dynamic scheduling and chunk size one when the usable team has more than one thread.
